title: Generating two design samples
description: You can compare how the two synthetic samples are constructed and summarized.

steps.description: You set n to 30 and generate sample A from a lognormal distribution. size uses n as the number of observations.
Sample B uses the same sigma and sample size with a different mean parameter. Both samples come from the existing random generator.

steps.question: Do these print statements report individual observations?
steps.answer: No. Each reports its sample's arithmetic mean and median.

steps.description: You see one summary line for each design. In the supplied recording, B's mean and median are both lower than A's.
